H3_write_path_propagation.note: H3 has the same content signature as H1.  Test R already refuted the H3 slot-mapping drift hypothesis; any H1-style signal here is thus attributable to content (paged-slot leakage from rejected branches), not to write-path misrouting.

verdict.label: H2_suspected_tail_only
reasons: All matched pairs agree on accepted-prefix content, but tree and chain disagree at tail (future-position) entries.  Since tail entries are newly computed each iter, this points at the tree-specific precompute write-back window rather than stale accepted-prefix content.
